closed_findings.detail: Failed temporary builds call a separate raw copier before cleanup, record BUILD_FAILED_RAW_ONLY/partial_build/fixture_usable=false/no qualification, and retain original byte/mode values. Evidence-capture and cleanup BaseException paths add notes without replacing the original exception. Success custody remains emitted only after final full custody checks.

Resolved evidence destination is frozen into the fixture. A warm call with a changed, newly selected or removed destination refuses before returning the fixture; it cannot silently omit a newly requested export.

retained_boundary: If evidence capture itself fails, original raw preservation is incomplete and no successful custody is emitted. In particular, a partial success-export directory may prevent the separate failed-build copier from creating the same destination; the original exception remains primary and temporary cleanup is still attempted. This is not a complete failure-evidence capture claim.
No POSIX timestamp, inode or symlink-topology preservation is inferred from the new byte/mode copier.
